name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, giving us a measurable quality bump without extra compute cost. Trade-off: it only works on still frames, so we’ll need a separate step for video depth consistency.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under motion because it’s still a still-frame tool. RealVisXL 4.0 locks us into Anthropic’s pipeline—if they change pricing or access, we’re stuck. Test both: run InstantX on 100 still frames and RealVisXL on 100 video clips; compare face fidelity and compute cost. The artifact is the benchmark report.
